ntm:machine_solar_boiler.operation: process=heat/heat_per_water_mb (Java int division); display=process BEFORE capacity limits; process=max(0,min(process,waterFill,(steamCapacity-steamFill)/steam_per_water_mb)); consume process water and produce process*steam_per_water_mb steam. Reset heat=0 every server tick, including unused heat and remainder.
ntm:machine_solar_boiler.tick_order: Mirrors add heat during their own server tick; the boiler processes its current accumulator then resets it. Preserve tick order rather than inventing stored thermal capacity.

ntm:solar_mirror.operation: If targetY<mirrorY, turn off and return. sun=savedSkyLightAtMirror-skylightSubtracted-sky_light_subtraction. If sun<=0 or the block above the mirror cannot see sky, turn off and return; otherwise isOn=true. Only if the tile at (targetX,targetY-1,targetZ) is a solar boiler, add sun to its heat accumulator. isOn can be true without a valid boiler.

targeting.target: Tool stores boiler core position with Y+1, then sets the mirror target.
targeting.angle_condition: dx*dx+dz*dz <= dy*dy; measured from mirror to stored target, inclusive.
targeting.validation: Distance and angle are checked by ItemMirrorTool when linking, not by the mirror on each tick; the mirror only checks targetY>=mirrorY and solar visibility.

runtime_gaps: Mirror tool is equipment backlog; linking, sky-light/weather sampling and beam rendering require runtime support.

ntm:machine_stirling.heat_input: Only IHeatSource immediately below. heatSrc=trunc(sourceHeat*diffusion); if positive, consume exactly heatSrc and add to heat. Otherwise heat=max(heat-max(heat/1000,1),0).
ntm:machine_stirling.tick_order: Update ports and provide previous powerBuffer first. If hasCog: reset powerBuffer=0, pull heat, powerBuffer=trunc(heat*efficiency), process overspeed. If no cog: reset overspeed/warnCooldown, decrement positive residual powerBuffer by1. Reset heat=0 at tick end.
ntm:machine_stirling.buffer: Per-tick output, not accumulated storage; getMaxPower()=powerBuffer and getProviderSpeed()=hasCog ? powerBuffer : 0.

overspeed.condition: heat>maxHeat; consecutive ticks increment overspeed, otherwise reset0; failure when overspeed>limit (strictly greater).
overspeed.failure: Set hasCog=false, explosion strength5 without fire or block damage, eject EntityCog; current powerBuffer remains but provider speed becomes0.

ntm:machine_stirling.source_config_gap: maxHeatNormal/maxHeatSteel are configurable fields but maxHeat() uses hardcoded 300/1500; preserve the effective literals. External config overrides are not applied in this snapshot.
runtime_gaps: Cog loss/repair, missing-cog block-item metadata1, explosion/projectile, thermal/power networks, ports, animation and multiblock require runtime support.
